config.title: Heartland Road Atlas
config.subtitle: Museums, architecture, Americana and parks in eight states, with driving times from Champaign, IL
config.guideIntro: Trip regions grouped by typical driving time from Champaign, so you can match a guide to the time you have: a day trip, an overnight or a long weekend. Driving times come from OpenStreetMap routing without traffic, so allow extra time for stops and city driving.

extraGuides.title: Chicago
extraGuides.intro: Chicago has its own guide with more than a hundred sites. Drive about 2 h 20 min, or take Amtrak from Champaign to Union Station in about 2 h 30 min and explore by L and bus.
